school: Weill Cornell Medicine / Memorial Sloan Kettering / Cornell University / Rockefeller University
program: Tri-Institutional PhD Program in Computational Biology and Medicine (CBM)

requirements.quote: Extensive training in quantitative disciplines, including linear algebra, statistics, computer programming, as well as foundational knowledge in biology.
An undergraduate or master’s degree in computer science, math, physics, engineering, computational biology, or another discipline that includes a strong quantitative component.
We look for applicants who have training (e.g., coursework) in both mathematics/computation and biology; however, such “dual” background is not a requirement.

problems: Apply page lists these under 'applicants are minimally expected to have' (recorded as required); FAQ says a dual math/computation + biology background is sought but not required (recorded as recommended).
